messages.text: server/report/pdfRenderer.ts: renderReportPdf(document: ReportDocument): Promise<Buffer> replaces renderReportPdf(model: ReportModel). It draws one A4 sheet per document page and rejects with PageOverflowError (also exported from pdfRenderer.ts) when a page is too tall, or with a plain Error if the sheet count differs from document.pages.length. server/services/reportService.ts must now call renderReportPdf(buildDiagnosisDocument({ companyName, completedAt, generatedAt: new Date(), result, brand, actionProgress, includeAnswers, diagnosisInput })); until then tsc --noEmit fails at reportService.ts(70,9) and tests/api/reportRoutes.test.ts fails with 500. That test file also still asserts the v1 texts (for example 'Nenhum risco encontrado nas suas respostas', the 'dimensão mais fraca' sentence), which the new document no longer prints.

Remaining checks for the phase, not run here: grayscale print of the dimensions page of an exported PDF (AC-ra-07, steps: export a diagnosis with a score under 50, print or convert the page to grayscale, confirm each bar shows 'N de 100', the dashed '50' line and, under the line, a hatched fill with 'abaixo de 50'; each matrix mark shows its number); e2e export and open (AC-ra-05 e2e, AC-ra-17..19) once reportService and the routes are rewired; pnpm build after reportService is updated.

The renderer relies on these ReportDocument conventions from buildDiagnosisDocument: the matrix and risk list are adjacent blocks ('riskMatrix' then 'riskList') on the risks page and are drawn side by side; page.title is printed as the sheet heading on every page except the one holding the 'cover' block; the footer text comes from document.footer.text. Nothing in your files had to change.
